items.summary: 华住会首张联名信用卡，招行携手万事达推出：首年 0 年费、消费 6 笔免次年年费；日常消费也能攒华住会积分，积分可抵扣房费，华住旗下 13000+ 家酒店通兑。
items.title: 招商银行华住会联名信用卡首发
items.title_en: CMB Launches First Huazhu Co-Branded Credit Card with Mastercard
items.summary_en: China Merchants Bank and Mastercard launch the first Huazhu co-branded credit card: no annual fee in year one, waived for year two with 6 purchases. Everyday spending also earns Huazhu points redeemable for stays at 13,000+ Huazhu hotels.

items.summary: 2026 年以来，多家银行发布信用卡停发公告，如建设银行龙卡变形金刚主题信用卡、民生银行抖音联名信用卡等，老一代联名卡持续调整；持卡人留意换发与权益变更通知。
items.title: 多家银行年内发布信用卡停发公告
items.title_en: Several Banks Announce Credit Card Discontinuations This Year
items.summary_en: Since 2026, multiple banks have announced credit card discontinuations — e.g. CCB's Long Card Transformers card and CMBC's Douyin co-branded card — as older co-branded lines keep being reshuffled. Cardholders should watch for replacement and benefit-change notices.

items.summary: 平安银行与中国银联、腾讯云联合推出国内首张面向 AI 算力个人消费用户的借记卡，把大模型 Token 算力、AI 办公学习工具纳入权益体系；每月刷卡达标可获算力积分翻倍。
items.title: 平安银行「AI 智算卡」发布
items.title_en: Ping An Bank Launches 'AI Computing Card'
items.summary_en: Ping An Bank, China UnionPay and Tencent Cloud jointly launch China's first debit card for personal AI-computing users, bundling large-model token computing and AI office/study tools into its benefits; monthly spending targets can double computing points.

items.summary: 网商银行联合阿里云、芝麻企业信用、高德等生态伙伴，推出国内首张面向小微经营者的 AI 权益卡，提供 Token 试用、内容生成等 AI 应用权益。
items.title: 网商银行推出面向小微经营者的 AI 权益卡
items.title_en: MYbank Launches AI Benefits Card for Small Businesses
items.summary_en: MYbank, together with Alibaba Cloud, Zhima Enterprise Credit, Amap and other ecosystem partners, launches China's first AI benefits card for small business owners, with token trials and content-generation perks.

items.summary: 招商银行运通工程师信用卡推出专属 AI 权益，首创将 Token 纳入新户礼，成为国内首张搭载 Token 权益的信用卡。
items.title: 招行运通工程师信用卡上线 AI 权益
items.title_en: CMB Amex Engineer Card Adds AI Benefits
items.summary_en: China Merchants Bank's Amex Engineer credit card adds exclusive AI benefits, first to include tokens in its new-card gift — China's first credit card with built-in token benefits.

items.summary: 多家银行陆续将存量银联-Visa 双标磁条卡升级为芯片卡（如建设银行自 2025 年 12 月 25 日起对部分双标磁条卡升芯），升芯后有效期延长；双标卡不新增发行，仅面向存量。手持老双标卡的可留意银行的换卡通知。
items.title: 银联-Visa 双标卡「磁升芯」持续推进
items.title_en: UnionPay–Visa Dual-Brand Cards: Magnetic-to-Chip Upgrades Continue
items.summary_en: Banks keep upgrading legacy UnionPay–Visa dual-brand magnetic cards to chip (e.g. CCB began upgrading some dual-brand magnetic cards on Dec 25, 2025), extending validity; no new dual-brand cards are issued — existing holders only. Watch your bank's replacement notice if you hold an old dual-brand card.
